selection_rules.unknown_profile_behavior: Allow all practice, but keep course-specific evidence unassigned until the learner selects their actual course and framework.
selection_rules.date_rule: Course start is a transition clue, not automatic placement. Ask for school-confirmed framework when unclear; do not select from today’s date.
selection_rules.history_rule: Freeze framework, course, study path, criterion ID, source and content version on every evidence record. A later profile change never rewrites earlier records.
selection_rules.difficulty_rule: Never infer course or study path from basic, medium or high.
selection_rules.unsupported_course_note: Foundational literacy and Latinisation courses need a separate teaching design; this text-using starter does not cover them.

evidence_states.label: Not assessed
evidence_states.meaning: No usable observation for this activity and criterion.

evidence_states.label: Practised
evidence_states.meaning: An attempt exists. It has not established successful performance.

evidence_states.label: Observed with help
evidence_states.meaning: A specific successful action was reviewed; aids or prompts were used and are recorded.

evidence_states.label: Observed independently
evidence_states.meaning: A specific successful action was reviewed without task-specific aids on this attempt. This is not mastery or course completion.

evidence_rules.review_note: Save the actual action, evidence excerpt, reviewer type (learner, educator or provisional automated feedback), limitations and help used. Keyword matching alone cannot promote an observation.
evidence_rules.listening: Record audio played, text visibility, replay and translation. If the answer or transcript was visible before responding, keep listening unassessed; record supported multimodal practice separately.
evidence_rules.reading: Require an answer based on the displayed text. Audio reading or translation assistance must be recorded; listening to it alone is not independent reading.
evidence_rules.speaking: Typed turns are not speaking evidence. Speech transcripts may support limited content observations after correction; they cannot establish pronunciation, prosody, fluency or comprehensibility from audio.
evidence_rules.writing: Dictation or copied phrase text is not independent writing. Keep input provenance and mark unknown provenance as unknown rather than assuming independence.
evidence_rules.help: Phrase hints, translation, model answers, notes, transcript visibility, replay and slow audio remain visible with the attempt. With-help is useful evidence, not a failure.
evidence_rules.missing: Never average missing skills into a score or infer one skill from another. Keep each unmapped or unobserved area unassessed.
evidence_rules.progress_example: In this supported request you explained what you needed. Next, try responding to a follow-up before opening a phrase hint.

coverage.scope: Three original everyday scenes and linked tasks; all criterion links are partial.
coverage.unlinked_rule: A selected course or domain with no matching task link is shown as not covered, not failed.

learning_hypothesis.claim: Learner-chosen meaning and feelings may make practice relevant; improved retention is an untested hypothesis.
learning_hypothesis.method: Offer optional self-described feelings and fictional alternatives. Compare later phrase recall and transfer, not enjoyment alone.
learning_hypothesis.privacy: No emotion inference from voice. A personal reason or feeling is optional; fictional context works equally well.

provenance.scenario_authorship: Original BP5 fictional material, 2026-11-01; no national test or commercial lesson items.
provenance.source_review: Current HTML plus linked seven-page consolidated PDF; downloaded 28-page 2026:67 regulation, extracted relevant pages and visually checked transition and criterion pages.
uncertainties: Task difficulty and support have not been calibrated with learners.
Mappings and feedback need review by a qualified SFI educator.
No reliability, readiness accuracy or retention improvement has been validated.
